title: More info from Banor

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Yo Boss. You got something on your mind?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yo Boss. You got something on your mind?

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Before he left? He didn't say much.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Before he left? He didn't say much.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Oh really? Well, what can I help you with?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh really? Well, what can I help you with?

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: You might want to take it down a few degrees Boss. I don't have that much more face to lose.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You might want to take it down a few degrees Boss. I don't have that much more face to lose.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Dunno boss.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Dunno boss.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Well... Thaddeus offered me a ticket, but he said there would be a cost. He was right.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well... Thaddeus offered me a ticket, but he said there would be a cost. He was right.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: There's a place called Egress. A kind of... metro station. But it doesn't work any more. Not the way it's 'sposed to. Anyway, you need a ticket to go there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's a place called Egress. A kind of... metro station. But it doesn't work any more. Not the way it's 'sposed to. Anyway, you need a ticket to go there.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Yeah. But I can't talk about it. It's not that I don't WANT to talk about it. You get me? I CAN'T talk about it. Some gifts, once given, can't be given back.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. But I can't talk about it. It's not that I don't WANT to talk about it. You get me? I CAN'T talk about it. Some gifts, once given, can't be given back.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Look, all I can say is this: if you go to Egress, you won't be the same afterwards. Sometimes when you crawl into a secret place, it's not easy to back out. You have to keep going to the end, and when you come out the other side, you won't be the same as when you went in.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, all I can say is this: if you go to Egress, you won't be the same afterwards. Sometimes when you crawl into a secret place, it's not easy to back out. You have to keep going to the end, and when you come out the other side, you won't be the same as when you went in.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: I'll send you a Nav Point, alright? But I still say you should forget this whole thing. And if you can't... well, just don't lose yourself down there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll send you a Nav Point, alright? But I still say you should forget this whole thing. And if you can't... well, just don't lose yourself down there.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I need to ask you about something Thaddeus said.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I need to ask you about something Thaddeus said.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I need to ask you about something Thaddeus said.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I need to ask you about something Thaddeus said.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not something he said before he left. Something he said after.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not something he said before he left. Something he said after.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Not something he said before he left. Something he said after.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Not something he said before he left. Something he said after.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Don't play dumb, Banor. It suits you too well.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't play dumb, Banor. It suits you too well.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Don't play dumb, Banor. It suits you too well.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Don't play dumb, Banor. It suits you too well.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Be straight with me Banor, OK?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Be straight with me Banor, OK?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Be straight with me Banor, OK?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Be straight with me Banor, OK?

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: I'll try boss. I always do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll try boss. I always do.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What is Egress?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What is Egress?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Come on Banor. You let it slip a few times now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Come on Banor. You let it slip a few times now.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Come on Banor. You let it slip a few times now.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Come on Banor. You let it slip a few times now.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Don't lie to me Banor.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't lie to me Banor.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A ticket to Egress?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A ticket to Egress?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are you talking about Banor?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are you talking about Banor?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What are you talking about Banor?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What are you talking about Banor?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is that where Thaddeus went?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is that where Thaddeus went?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You can tell me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You can tell me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If you can't talk about it, I understand.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you can't talk about it, I understand.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If you can't talk about it, I understand.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If you can't talk about it, I understand.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll bear that in mind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll bear that in mind.
